defeated_student_causes.why_failed: Sorting adjacency lists alone does not establish global lexicographic selection unless every candidate is compared or traversal order is rigorously controlled; its partial lexicographic-selection strategy can choose the wrong triangle.

It breaks based on the current edge's first endpoint (`if best is not None and u > best[0]: break`), although the input edges are not guaranteed to be sorted by endpoint, so later edges can contain a lexicographically smaller triangle.
